title: One year of Longship operations: What's next for CCS in Europe?
summary: Workshop organised by Northern Lights with support from Carbon Management Europe, held in Brussels on 2 December 2026 (17:00–19:00) as a side event to the Industrial Carbon Management Summit. It reflects on Northern Lights' first year of operations, with Phase 2 expansion underway, and discusses how to expand CCS in Europe.
why_it_matters: First-year operating experience from the Longship ship-based chain is a rare real-world reference for shipping, terminal and storage-capacity assumptions in Nordic network models.
